title: Jewels of Japan with Mount Fuji
alt: The Shinkansen bullet train passing Mount Fuji, Japan
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Hakone
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Smart hotel in Kyobashi, a short walk from Tokyo station

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from Matsuya Ginza through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip
activities.match: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway, with the bullet train back into Tokyo at the end of the day.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights beside Tokyo station, with a full city day and a day out to Mount Fuji and Hakone that returns by bullet train.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · European styled hotel in Kita, close to Osaka station

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara day trip
activities.match: Kyoto and Nara Sightseeing Day Tour
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, Fushimi Inari's torii gates and then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, departing from Osaka.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Three nights in Osaka with a full day in Kyoto and Nara, and a free day for the food streets or a castle.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your hotel in Kyobashi
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk through Ginza
2: Breakfast, then a full day coach tour of the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway
Bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening
4: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Shinkansen bullet train south to Osaka
Check in at your hotel in Kita
Rest of the day free in the city
5: Breakfast, then a full day out to Kyoto and Nara
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The torii gate paths at Fushimi Inari
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
6: Breakfast and a free day in Osaka
Optional: Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
Optional: Osaka castle and its park
Optional: Universal Studios Japan for the day
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: A week is enough for Tokyo and Kansai if you let the bullet train do the work. This is that trip, nothing wasted.
expert.tip: Both hotels sit next to a main station, so the free day can become Himeji, Kobe or Nara again without a transfer.

summary: Seven days with three nights in central Tokyo for a city day and Mount Fuji with Hakone, then the Shinkansen to Osaka for three nights with a full day in Kyoto and Nara and a free day in the city.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip with bullet train return; Kyoto and Nara sightseeing day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
